video_title: Jayson Tatum shares EXPECTATIONS for Celtics in 2026-27

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on Jaylen Brown's departure and the new Celtics team
quotes.excerpt: we got new teammates and new guys we need to embrace and kind of move forward with that
quotes.quote: I would probably say his personality. He was a very funny guy to be around and obviously his presence will be missed in the city, in the organization, and on our team. But it is also like we got new teammates and new guys we need to embrace and kind of move forward with that.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his mental growth and health for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: I am in a much different head space on in a good way because I know I am practicing tomorrow
quotes.quote: I look back 12 months ago this time, I was very uncertain on this day if I was coming back to play, what that season was going to look like. So I am in a much different head space on in a good way because I know I am practicing tomorrow. I know I am back healthy. I know I am going to get back to doing what I love to do. So from that standpoint, that is where my eagerness and being excited about this new opportunity with this new group of guys is just a lot of things to be excited about.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his admiration for teammate Paul George
quotes.excerpt: he was definitely somebody I looked up to, kind of modeled some of my game after
quotes.quote: When I was in high school, college, especially even earlier in my career, he was definitely somebody I looked up to, kind of modeled some of my game after and watched a lot and lots of film on. So it is just kind of cool somebody that you can grow up being a fan of and watching can one day be your teammate.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his professional relationship with coach Joe Mazzulla
quotes.excerpt: me and Joe got a great deal of respect for each other and I understand Joe
quotes.quote: Me and Joe got a great deal of respect for each other and I understand Joe, he wants the best for this organization and his team and myself. And those three things kind of go hand in hand and I know that Joe requires a lot and expects a lot from me and that just kind of sets the tone for the rest of the group.
